purpose: Compare the two ACF-memory gate sources in the shared variable-token MambaACF AutoCon forecaster: a shared temporal hidden gate with shape [B,H,1] and a channel-specific variable-token gate with shape [B,H,C].
research_question: Under the same variable-token MambaACF AutoCon architecture, train-only raw ACF sidecar, signed global relation objective, data split, optimizer, and short budget, does sourcing the ACF-memory gate from restored variable-token states improve H96 forecasting over the hidden-state gate?
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory mechanism screen on ETTh1 and Traffic at H96 with three paired seeds and eight epochs. It is not confirmatory evidence and cannot establish a general Mamba, ACF, variable-token, accuracy, speed, or publication claim.
claim_boundary: Only paired descriptive deltas, gate activation, sidecar/config invariants, and separately measured resource costs may be reported. A favorable screen result requires a new reviewed replication and must not be pooled with other plans.

required_before_launch: human review of the hidden-versus-variable-token gate estimand
confirm the train-only ACF sidecar identity, lag contract, and dataset fingerprints
review the channel-scaled variable-token resource budget and run a separate resource smoke benchmark
freeze the plan hash, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root

prelaunch_gates: human review of the hidden-versus-variable-token gate estimand
confirm the train-only ACF sidecar identity, lag contract, and dataset fingerprints
review the channel-scaled variable-token resource budget and run a separate resource smoke benchmark
freeze the plan hash, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root

seed_policy.sidecar_policy: Fit the raw ACF sidecar from the training split only and require exact sidecar hash equality within every paired coordinate.
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh output root; do not copy metrics or checkpoints from another screen into this matrix.

phases.name: memory_gate_hidden_h96
phases.purpose: Reference arm: static train-only ACF memory gated from the final shared temporal hidden state, producing a broadcast gate with shape [B,H,1].

phases.name: memory_gate_variable_token_h96
phases.purpose: Treatment arm: the same static train-only ACF memory and variable-token forecast trunk, but gate each channel from restored variable-token states, producing shape [B,H,C].

MambaACFVariableAutoCon.provenance_rule: Persist the alias, executable model, and resolved overrides in every manifest record and config hash.

comparison_contract.one_factor_rule: The two phases must match on model alias and executable, variable-token trunk, channel order, sidecar, ACF lags and selector, relation objective and lambda, optimizer, scheduler, split, batch, and epoch budget. Only mamba_acf_memory_gate_mode may differ.
planned_contrasts: memory_gate_variable_token_h96 minus memory_gate_hidden_h96 for scaled MSE and scaled MAE
dataset-specific paired deltas for every seed
separately measured latency and peak-memory ratios
sidecar_invariants: exact acf_prior.npz hash equality within every dataset/seed pair
equal effective lags and relation candidate lags within every pair
train-only sidecar source; no validation or test target is read
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: Exploratory gate-source evidence only. Six paired coordinates can motivate a separately reviewed replication but cannot establish a general accuracy or efficiency advantage.

resource_contract.scope: Architecture-level gate cost estimate for d_model=32 and pred_len=96; it excludes Mamba backend overhead, optimizer state, data loading, and the rest of the forecast trunk.
resource_contract.measurement_policy: Before any launch, benchmark both modes with the same device, batch size, synthetic device-resident input, warmup, timed forwards, and deterministic source snapshot. Report median and p95 latency plus steady-state peak allocated/reserved memory; do not infer training speed from the MAC ratio alone.

engineering_budget.action_if_exceeded: stop the exploratory screen and do not promote variable-token gating without a new reviewed resource/accuracy design

stopping_rules: Do not launch without human review, a bound plan hash, approved launch sidecar, gate evidence, immutable source/environment provenance, and a fresh output root.

Invalidate the affected phase for any missing or duplicate dataset/horizon/seed coordinate, non-ok manifest record, non-finite metric, changed artifact hash, source/provenance drift, or sidecar/effective-lag mismatch.
Analyze six paired coordinates and each dataset separately; never use test metrics to select an arm, add seeds, change horizons, or tune the gate after launch.

Stop and do not promote variable-token gating if it is favorable on fewer than 4/6 paired scaled-MSE coordinates, or on fewer than 2/3 seeds in either dataset, or if either dataset has mean relative scaled-MSE degradation greater than 1%.
Stop on the resource gate if the variable-token median latency or peak allocated memory exceeds 1.25 times hidden mode under the predeclared benchmark protocol.

If the accuracy and resource criteria are mixed, report the screen as exploratory and require a separately frozen replication; do not add a strength-order, conditioning, or gate interaction arm after seeing results.
